outputs.article:
Have you ever seen Law and Order or CSI
Why This Matters
Most people face this without understanding it. Someone is running in Central Park When Jesus spoke, demons fled
The Reality
 This is where many stay trapped.
How It Works
Teaching opens with personal vulnerability and transforms through encounter with Christ.
The Turning Point
Until something changed.
What Became Possible
 This is not theory. This is transformation.
Divine Authority
Jesus Christ is the answer.
Scripture Support
John 10:10 - I have come that they may have life abundantly
Romans 6:9 - Christ dies no more; death has no dominion
2 Corinthians 5:17 - If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation

EPISODE TITLE: From Bondage to Breakthrough
Have you ever seen Law and Order or CSI In this episode we explore how people rationalize their bondage and how true transformation comes through direct encounter with God.
KEY TAKEAWAYS
1. Have you ever seen Law and Order or CSI
2. Someone is running in Central Park
3. When Jesus spoke, demons fled
SCRIPTURE
• John 10:10 - I have come that they may have life abundantly
• Romans 6:9 - Christ dies no more; death has no dominion
• 2 Corinthians 5:17 - If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation
